items.description: Scoopmap.net allows users to view breaking news around the world by leveraging two APIs. Discover hot spots and articles written by high quality newspapers such as the Guardian and New York Times.
Explore related Twitter trends and see livestreams, timelines and the top retweets for that trend.

This mashup feeds the semantic web service Calais every five minutes with the most recent tweets behind the current twitter trends in order to determine tags for these trends. With the resulting tag set at your fingertips.
Aggregate news from all around the web, provide related stories, wikinews, tags, wikipedia links, flickr photos , tweets and more...

Newstaggr is a new way for browsing news. It gathers news from sources like Reuters, CNN, New York Times, and BBC, and it uses Calais to semantically tag them and create a tag cloud for 12 categories.
World Bank-produced Google map on doing business in 175 countries. Countries are color-coded for ease of doing business there: easy, moderate, and difficult, in green, yellow and red respectively.

Pub Crawl uses the foursquare venues API to provide a way for you to plan a pub crawl in a neighbourhood and see the blokes who will likely be your drinking buddies there. Photos of mayors represent the venues (pubs and/or bars) and are ordered with the closest venues first. Click a photo to drilldown to the foursquare venue page and start your crawl!
View radar and cloud cover superimposed on an animated Virtual Earth map. Adjust the degree of transparency for the weather data to see more or less of the underlying map.
MapMyEvent is a portal that delivers map information for any event along with information about hotels and landmarks around it. You can use Mapmyevent to generate customized link for your own events.
A mashup showing Motorcycle Parking Sopts in San Francisco using Google Maps

Need to create a map for your Facebook page? Why send readers to a google or mapquest map when you could give them another reason to go to your Facebook page instead? Or keep them on your Facebook page. The BlockWild map application gives you the ability to create a map with an informative popup card on your Facebook page for events, rentals, classifieds, or anything you want to map.
An easy interface to search for Flickr images. Includes advanced options to search by license type or date posted.
QuickBlox MapChat is a simple plugin for WordPress, that adds a MapChat (chat integrated with map) widget to your website. You can chat over a map or in chat room.
See the Forbes Magazine list of the Drunkest Cities in America mapped.
Spying on FriendFeed public timeline in real time and more.

Weglore is a location based photo sharing app that allows users to explore the globe with map navigation and photo markers. The photo series incorporates smart social functions that enable filtering of unwanted photos and sharing photos pertaining to a similar subject. The Weglore mobile app users geolocation to add metadata to photos, and enables users to subscribe to photos aggregated to a particular location, with optional notification settings as well as other functions. The app is free and can be downloaded for Android from Google Play.
50 random World Heritage Sites on a Google Map. Each time you reload it shows another 50 random sites. With embedded photos and links to details on each site.
Find and rate hotties from Google Streetview.
Tallest skyscrapers in the world measured to the architectural top.
Mashup screensaver shows the latest New York Times online news illustrated with current relevant crowd-sourced Flickr photos in real-time. And most times it is quite badass photo editor.
Online running log service with local search and sharing using Google maps. Running log has nice graphing features.
Test your knowledge of where countries are located with this interactive map quiz.
Real time Google maps of current parking availability in the San Francisco Bay Area.
MapSkip allows you to share stories and photos about the places that are important in your life.

With DocuSign for Google Apps (Gmail, Calendar, Google Docs and many more), an enterprise user of Google Apps can access DocuSign to send envelopes from any application through the MORE link in the upper navigation bar.
SDB Explorer has been made as an industry leading graphical user interface (GUI) to explore Amazon SimpleDB service thoroughly and in a very efficient and user friendly way.
An AJAX-powered Twitter client that allows for logging in to multiple accounts simultaneously. Hashtags displayed in ComboTweet are automatically linked into Tagalus.
A smart way to browse and locate Flickr images on a large map of the world. Cruise Flickr photos, tags and people based on geotagged location. Combines the power of Google maps along with Flickr.
Map of March 2008 protests in Tibet, and ensuing events. With photos, summaries, and links to supporting documentation about the Tibetan Centre for Human Rights and Democracy, TCHRD, website.
KeepTheRecord provides an instant online conference call for up to 10 participants, with only one click. When the conference is over, everyone gets to keep a copy of the recording.

Text2residents.com is a simple and effective way for multifamily and senior living management to communicate instantly with residents, their families and staff members via text messages to their mobile phones and devices.
Unlock knowledge of the local market and gain an edge when buying or selling real estate. Answers are provided by local real estate agents eager to represent you in a transaction.
Find a roommate using Google Maps. Roommates enter the location of where they would be willing to live, and then you can search based on this.
The 99designs Tasks Slack Bot is a full featured graphic design assistant application in Slack.
The bogomash mashup is a buy one get one free promotions aggregator.
Enter a zip code when you do a Jobster job search and see the locations plotted on a Google Map.
Map to show you the current location of the Adobe on AIR promotional tour bus.

Teletka is an online/phone service that allows you to connect your Facebook account with phone numbers. Once you are officially authenticated with Teletka, you can start posting audio messages to your Facebook wall. All you have to do is call Teletka and leave a message.
This mashup combines job listings from Indeed with company reviews from Glassdoor for job searches within the data science.
Shows locations of Speed Cameras on a map. Contains most speed cameras in Europe. This information is not intended to encourage speeding.
An Australian Real Estate Search engine. Found results are displayed in Google Earth and on the Google Map.

Daily Crypto lets you add crypto tokens to easily track their prices, price change & 24h highs and lows in your new browser tab! Tired of clicking through multiple sites, watchlists and more to track your crypto token prices? Daily Crypto replaces your default tab, and lets you easily access latest token prices of your curated selection of crypto tokens. From latest token prices, to price %age changes, 24 hour highs, lows and market cap ranks - we keep you updated.
A map of all of the economic protests in Myanmar, aka Burma.
Simple and fast album cover art engine.
View incoming flights into 7 major US cities. Altitude, speed, heading and flight path are all interactively displayed on the map. Be air traffic control.
View mutual connections across Facebook, Twitter, and Linkedin.
Combines YouTube videos, Flickr photos, Last.fm albums and Amazon books, grouped by Wikipedia category.
An app that uses SoundClouds API to play songs from the cloud on your profile. PHP source code available.
Filmfinder is a mobile application that lets users browse and search for movies and TV series. Filmfinder uses a few different APIs for their database, including Youtube and Movie DB.
See the location of elaborate Christmas lights displays. Readers can add comments and vote for favorites.
Did you know that 64% of the readers of Dan Brown's latest novel are male. Bookhu, the Gender Compatibility Engine for books, helps you find suitable books based on your gender.
View the lines and stops of the metro system in Naples, Italy.

Toronto apartment rental search engine which mashes Google maps with apartment reviews, rental listings via Craigslist and property managers, subway stops and grocery stores. Renters can search by Toronto neighbourhood, intersection and subway station.
Instantly call everyone in your team using group call and toll-free conference calls for team leaders. Call at any time with no need to schedule, or hold scheduled calls with up to 20 participants.

Lets a business share docs from their Microsoft SkyDrive over SMS via Twilio. Go to the app which is running on Windows Azure, set which SkyDrive account to use, and select a public file to share over SMS. Customers (incl. potential customers) can call the Twilio number associated with the #docs deployment and text link to get a link to whatever doc you're currently sharing (for deals, specials, marketing info, etc.) For the sample #docs deployment, call my Twilio number (415)599-2671, enter passcode 7392-3266, and message link.
